11. Revision of option.Government servants are given an opportunity to re-exercise their option within three months from 12-12-2018 in terms of Rules 5 and 6. Arrears on account of revised pay already drawn from 1-1-2016 up to the date from which they opt to come over to the revised pay structure shall be recovered. - GID, Rule 6 of CCS (RP) Rules, 2016.
